hero.title: Save the Hills of Chihuahua
hero.subtitle: A social activism association for the protection of natural areas in Chihuahua such as hills, rivers, lakes, lagoons, dams, mountains, canyons, and the flora and fauna that inhabit them.
hero.description: Currently we are only in Chihuahua capital but we seek to go to the whole state in the future. We are apolitical, we carry out demonstrations and changes that seek to inspire and make changes for the common sustainability of the inhabitants, raising awareness about the dangers of gentrification and also allowing awareness about the proper use of natural resources and how to make better use of them.

map.title: Area Mapping
map.description: We identify and catalog areas of high ecological value for their priority protection.
